conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Yes, EEG has some drawbacks, including its limited spatial resolution, meaning it's not as precise as fMRI in pinpointing exact locations of brain activity. It can also be affected by artifacts from muscle movements or eye blinks.
